steps: Sign up free at respondent.io and complete your profile (identity verified once).
Get matched to studies and invited when you fit (typically 1-3 invites a month).
Pass each study's screening questions; confirm scheduling with the researcher.
Complete the session (interviews, surveys, diary studies — duration and incentive shown upfront).
Receive payment via Tremendous, usually within a few days (typically 48 hrs after session).
timing: Paid via Tremendous, typically 48 hrs after your session and usually within a few days (official participant page).

repeatable.cadence: new studies matching your background get sent to you — typically 1–3 a month — and you can complete each one you qualify for

maximize: Same Respondent playbook as R6613: full professional profile, fast applications, complete every booked session. Survey-style sessions average $75 for about 45 minutes, with most sessions paying $50-$250, and Tremendous pays out typically 48 hours after your session — usually within a few days. Senior and professional backgrounds get the most invitations (typically 1-3 a month).
who_pays: Respondent sends your incentive through Tremendous once your session is verified — with no fees.
who_qualifies: 18+ with a free participant profile and one-time verified identity; webcam and microphone for video interviews (or async diary studies). Open to consumers and professionals.
work_available: You’re only invited when a real study matches your background — typically 1–3 invites a month. No junk surveys, but no volume guarantee either.
what_gets_accepted: Complete the session and have it verified — each study also requires passing its screening questions first.
costs_and_unpaid_time: Free to join, no credit card, never asked to pay. Unpaid time: building your profile and verifying your identity once, plus passing screeners per study.
when_cash_arrives: Via Tremendous, typically 48 hours after your session and usually within a few days.
